import OAI.NumberTheory.DirichletL.Nonvanishing
import Lean

open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  for name in [``OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re,
      ``OAI.DirichletCharacter.LFunction_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re] do
    let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms name
    for ax in axioms do
      unless ax == ``propext || ax == ``Classical.choice || ax == ``Quot.sound do
        throwError "Forbidden transitive axiom {ax} in {name}"
    logInfo m!"EXACT TARGET AUDIT PASSED: {name}; {axioms}"

set_option pp.universes true
set_option pp.fullNames true
#check @OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re
#check @OAI.DirichletCharacter.LFunction_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re

-- Check the actual Mathlib target, not a renamed local analytic surrogate.
example {s : ℂ} (hs : (7/8 : ℝ) < s.re) : riemannZeta s ≠ 0 :=
  OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re hs

import Foundation.RiemannQuadraticXiTransfer
import OAI.NumberTheory.DirichletL.Nonvanishing
import Lean

/-! Isolated integration of independently audited upstream results with the
existing actual arithmetic flow. No production dependency/configuration change. -/
open OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation

theorem stardust_upstream_zero_time_strip (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : RiemannRealOrderFlow.flow a 0 z=0) : |z.im| ≤ (3/4 : ℝ) :=
  RiemannQuadraticXiTransfer.zero_im_strip_of_seven_eighths
    (fun s hs => OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re hs) a ha z hz

theorem stardust_upstream_quadratic_zero_time_strip (z : ℂ)
    (hz : RiemannEvenFlow.flow 1 0 z=0) : |z.im| ≤ (3/4 : ℝ) := by
  apply stardust_upstream_zero_time_strip 1 (by norm_num) z
  simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using (RiemannRealOrderFlow.flow_nat 1 0 z).trans hz

open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  for name in [``stardust_upstream_zero_time_strip,
      ``stardust_upstream_quadratic_zero_time_strip] do
    let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms name
    for ax in axioms do
      unless ax == ``propext || ax == ``Classical.choice || ax == ``Quot.sound do
        throwError "Forbidden integrated transitive axiom {ax} in {name}"
    logInfo m!"INTEGRATED ACTUAL TARGET AUDIT PASSED: {name}; {axioms}"

set_option pp.universes true
set_option pp.fullNames true
#check @stardust_upstream_zero_time_strip
#check @stardust_upstream_quadratic_zero_time_strip
